title: Upper Body Mobility - B
texts:  Upper Body Mobility - B Premium Workout
Chest stretch, cat stretch, bicep stretch, and QL stretch

Complete 3 sets of each of the following static positions holding the most stretched position possible where you feel slight discomfort but not pain.  To help develop flexibility each position will be held for 60 seconds. Complete all sets of each position before moving to the next exercise.  

Rest for 1 minute between sets and 2 minutes between exercises.
